system.description: You establish a two-way data link with the target's cyberbrain. If linked with more than one target simultaneously, you may act as a relay so that everyone linked with you can also communicate with each other (though you will overhear everything). Language is still a factor, but this barrier may be overcome by transmitting sounds, images, sensor data, and other feeds. The link is not carried over the Mesh and cannot be intercepted by conventional means.
